name: V — exhausted interest reserve, rolled-up development finance
note:
R14 spec §4 (the C1 correction). A hand-derivable positive case for the NEW reserve-headroom term: a rolled-up facility whose interest reserve (200,000p) is far smaller than the interest the 12-month, 1%-per-month schedule actually accrues, so the reserve is consumed within a few months while the facility keeps drawing against construction. The gross facility (net 12,000,000 + reserve 200,000 = 12,200,000, since committed_gross_facility_pence is null) is also tight enough against the net facility that the gross-headroom draw cap (spec §4.2(c)) binds before construction finishes — ledger month 9's draw is capped to 495,979p (not the full 600,000p due) and month 10 draws nothing at all, so `funding_gap_pence` is a genuine, independently-computed 704,021p. This is a POSITIVE case for the corpus's 'shortfall ⇒ funding_gap' implication (test-cases.md §2), not a counter-example: unlike fixture P (calc ≤2.12.0's phantom, now closed) this fixture's shortfall and its funding gap are both real.

Full month-by-month ledger, the §5.10 series for m = 1..12, and the rejected-correction comparison (spec §11 guard 2) are hand-derived in docs/financial-model/test-cases.md §20.1, BEFORE either engine ran on this document.

DESIGN, verbatim from the R14 Task 2 brief: headline cost mode, England/NI, single-tranche sale at term (route sell_all, no sales_phasing), retain_all: false, no programme network (auto windows: construction spreads straight-line over months 1..10 for a 12-month term, spec §6). Purchase price 10,000,000p (acquisition tax 0p — the non-residential SDLT band's nil-rate threshold is 15,000,000p, spec/fixtures/tax/acquisition-tax-tables.json, so a 10,000,000p consideration falls entirely in the 0% band); construction 6,000,000p (100,000p/sqm × 60 sqm, contingency_pct 0, no compliance allowances); every professional/statutory fee field 0; day-one advance 6,000,000p against the 10,000,000p acquisition, the balance (4,000,000p) funded from the single confirmed cash equity source, which is then fully exhausted — every construction draw from ledger month 1 onward falls to the facility alone. GDV 30,000,000p from two units (15,000,000p each), sold whole at term (month 11).

WHY THE RESERVE IS SIZED THIS WAY: at 1%/month, ledger month 0 alone accrues 60,000p of rolled-up interest — already 30% of the 200,000p reserve — and the reserve is fully consumed partway through ledger month 3 (cumulative capitalised interest crosses 200,000p between C(2) = 199,866p and C(3) = 279,865p). From ledger month 3 onward `reserve_headroom` is pinned at 0 by the max(0, …) floor, so every month's forecast interest beyond that point is an uncredited addition to remaining cost with nothing on the funding side to offset it — the exhausted-reserve scenario the fixture is named for.
